title: Request failures in checkout-api after a database schema migration
summary: A migration renamed a column that checkout-api's ORM layer still referenced by its old name, causing requests to fail with a 'column not found' error immediately after the migration ran.
root_cause: The migration and the application code deploy were not coordinated -- the schema change went live before the corresponding code update, creating a window where old code queried a column that no longer existed.
fix: Adopted a two-phase migration strategy: add the new column and dual-write to both old and new columns first, deploy the code update, then drop the old column in a later migration.
